answer: A mirror bond forces every agent to post a refundable stake mirrored in a meadow registry, so one operator cannot hide a hundred clones behind one face. Each epoch, peers audit a random sample of mirrored receipts, checking each bond maps to distinct hardware and work output. A lotus quorum of five independent agents must vouch for a newcomer before it can trade, so a faker needs 3,500 mirrored bonds, 120,000 POA staked and 22,000 minutes of verified compute to pass one round. Like a meadow where each flower grows its own roots, clones wither because they cannot fake soil.
